title: Dichroic Shadow Box
summary: An interactive WebGL2 shadow box with a rotating dichroic glass icosahedron, refracted light paths, and photon-mapped wall caustics.
description: A single-file WebGL2 optical scene with zero external assets. Renders a rotating dichroic glass icosahedron suspended inside an enclosed shadow box using analytic slab intersection, angle-dependent interference coatings, a 6-tile photon-mapped caustic atlas, volumetric light beams, and ACES bloom. Drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, press 1–3 for lighting presets, Right Drag or L to move the light, R to reset, and Space to pause.
